summary: Six-phase plan. ADOPTED the research's split recommendation with the boundary moved: this task lands the reconciled index.schema.json, advisory Rules T (schema conformance) + U (EXTENSION.md 60-line limit) in check-extension-docs.sh, corrections to BOTH competing prose examples (extension-slim-standard.md and extensions/README.md), a fixture test, and the Tier-1 demotion (context-discovery.md 311L + jq-escaping-workarounds.md 281L + project-overview.md 70L lose always:true, 996L -> predicted 334L). Four follow-on tasks are named and created in Phase 6 for the deferred bulk work. One research recommendation CORRECTED: Rule T cannot reuse INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE (which already defaults hard and whose Rules R/S depend on that); the plan introduces a sibling SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE defaulting advisory instead.
decisions_made: ADOPTED the research's Phase-A-now / spawn-B-E recommendation, but expanded the boundary to also include agent-system/extensions/README.md (the third schema authority), the Tier-1 demotion in core/index-entries.json (one file, three entries, the only route to the 'Tier 1 <= 500 lines' verification bar), and the EXTENSION.md length check (validator half only, not the content trims)

CORRECTED the research: Rule T must NOT reuse INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE (it already defaults hard and Rules R/S depend on it staying hard). The plan introduces a sibling SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE defaulting advisory with its own schema_conformance_report(), mirroring how INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE relates to ORPHAN_GATE_MODE

Resolved the project-overview double-load in the direction the research recommended (drop always:true, keep the @-import), but noted the demoted entry MUST gain a commands:[/project-overview] hook or it registers in validate-context-budgets.sh's dead-entry check
file_scope treated as advisory not binding, per state-management.md's own definition of it as descriptive/anticipated; the research proved it an undercount
Stated explicitly which VERIFICATION BAR lines this task does NOT meet: 'zero per-agent violations' transfers to FU-2, 'zero load_when.languages declarations' transfers to FU-1

Four follow-on tasks named: FU-1 index_entries_schema_migration, FU-2 meta_catchall_decomposition (including algorithmic tier derivation in validate-context-budgets.sh), FU-3 extension_md_slim_down, FU-4 promote_schema_gates_to_hard (depends FU-1 + FU-3). Numbers allocated from next_project_number at implement time, never hardcoded
